scenes.title: A local direction, a finite step
scenes.concept_target: The sign of the derivative gives a local descent direction, but step size controls the actual update.

narration_cues.text: Start at x equals two on the curve x squared. The loss is four.
The slope here is positive four. A small move to the left lowers the loss.
narration_cues.sync_target: Show the tangent and slope label

narration_cues.text: With a learning rate of point two, subtract point eight. The next x is one point two, and the loss falls to one point four four.
narration_cues.sync_target: Move the point using the update rule

narration_cues.text: The direction came from local information. A much larger step can overshoot. Predict what happens if the learning rate becomes one point two.
narration_cues.sync_target: Keep the result visible and pose the changed case
